hooks.text: 背包物品可组合并融合出商店买不到的特殊装备
hooks.excerpt: Mix and match items in your backpack to create powerful combos. Purchase a variety of helpful items such as equipment, accessories, and moves from the shop, and fuse them to obtain special items that cannot be bought.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 招式存在互克，破防后衔接追击形成连招
hooks.excerpt: Connecting moves well will be crucial for victory—avoid moves that might counter each other, and build combos to allow you to quickly launch follow-up attacks after breaking through your opponent's guard.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 异步对战真人十局，十胜后挑战全球榜高手
hooks.excerpt: You undergo up to 10 battles per game, each against real players. Slash and slice your opponents in a bloody 1v1 fight to the finish. Players can battle at any time with no need to wait for an opponent to be online. After you win 10 battles in a game, you gain the chance to challenge the best players on the global leaderboard.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
